subject.title: feat(hooks): add ACP turn transcript save hook

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a documented `agent:turn:transcript:save` internal hook with saved/skipped/failed durability outcomes and ACP save-ordering semantics?
rationale: The code path is understandable and proven, but the decision changes OpenClaw's internal hook API and transcript durability lifecycle contract, which automation cannot accept on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Close Unsponsored Surface
options.body: Close this PR for now and ask for maintainer sponsorship before adding the transcript-save hook contract.

options.title: Sponsor And Refresh
options.body: Keep or reopen the PR only if a maintainer accepts the event name, payload, ordering, and compatibility implications, then require a clean current-base refresh.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Lifecycle Design
options.body: Handle transcript-save durability as part of the broader lifecycle-hook API discussion rather than landing this split contract alone.

recommendation.title: Close Unsponsored Surface
recommendation.body: Close this PR for now and ask for maintainer sponsorship before adding the transcript-save hook contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around internal hooks and transcript helper boundaries, and the remaining question is product/API ownership rather than a code repair.
